path_recording: repo-relative; temporary build paths reduced to <tmp>/<basename>

method.edit_set: two cells: `/` at c, one letter at c+1, each mirrored at c+26414
method.pair_source: consecutive-step cell pairs from a 400000-step loop-phase trace of the unmodified candidate, at/after the loop-entry cell 25976
method.phase_trigger: -f 25976 on every run; phase A = loader, phase B = print loop
method.store_detection: first p/* store executed within 8 STEPS of an IN: step (traced lines are not steps); immediate = exactly 1 step apart, and every event records the cell the machine executed as well as the cell edited
method.stdin: byte 81 (`Q`, the branch discriminator) then bytes 40..119
method.perturbation: byte at the position a traced read consumed replaced by 187; the stored value must move and match crazy(187, old)
method.census: store_map() over all 59049 old values, checked against a direct crazy_op evaluation on a stride-211 sample plus every measured state and reservoir (mismatch list published)

not_demonstrated: a double store of one byte into two cells: the jointly injective state pairs were measured from SEPARATE programs, and no single run was made to hold both states at once
